name: conformance-band
title: ConformanceBand
description: Conformance by operation: one cell per operation, with a spelled-out label and a visible summary in the full size.

a11y.pattern: <div role="img" aria-label="11 of 12 operations pass, 1 fails">
aria: The band is role="img" with a label that spells out the counts
Failed cells are hatched as well as colored; untested cells are outlined
The full size shows a visible percentage and counts as text
Percentage color is secondary: the numbers are always written
a11y.notes: Provide the same data as a table elsewhere on the page when the details matter.
